stories.title: Hidden Fire Hazards in Plain Sight
stories.description: Critical home safety areas that often go unnoticed but pose significant fire risks.

scenes.visual_prompt: A cinematic slow-pan across a peaceful, sun-drenched living room. Dust motes drift slowly through golden light beams. The camera moves with a smooth gimbal glide, revealing a modern home interior that feels safe and calm.
scenes.visual_reference: A cozy home interior that looks safe but hides small risks.
scenes.negative_prompt: text, watermark, smoke, fire, messy, dark, scary
scenes.narration: A safe home starts with noticing the small details that usually go unseen.

scenes.visual_prompt: A slow, dramatic macro-zoom into the dark opening of a dryer vent. Clumps of grey lint vibrate slightly as air huffs through the silver hose. The camera pushes deep into the texture of the trapped fibers.
scenes.visual_reference: Extreme close-up of lint buildup in a dryer exhaust pipe.
scenes.narration: Hidden lint buildup in dryer vents is a leading cause of preventable home fires.

scenes.visual_prompt: A low-angle tracking shot moving slowly alongside a power strip on a wooden floor. The camera orbits the tangled wires, focusing on a heavy adapter that is sagging out of the socket. Soft shadows shift as the camera circles.
scenes.visual_reference: A power strip with many electronic devices plugged in.
scenes.negative_prompt: text, watermark, sparks, fire, cartoonish, messy cables
scenes.narration: Overloading power strips can lead to overheating long before a breaker ever trips.

scenes.visual_prompt: The camera tilts upward slowly, starting from a stove top and rising to the range hood. It settles on a close-up of the metal mesh where amber grease droplets are slowly forming and glistening under the stovetop light.
scenes.visual_reference: A dirty kitchen grease filter under a vent hood.
scenes.negative_prompt: text, watermark, food, person cooking, fire
scenes.narration: Cooking grease trapped in range hood filters can ignite during high-heat cooking.

scenes.visual_prompt: A sharp, static close-up of a white smoke detector. A finger enters the frame and presses the 'Test' button, causing a small green LED light to blink rapidly. The camera has a very slight handheld shake for a realistic feel.
scenes.visual_reference: A smoke alarm being tested in a modern home.
scenes.negative_prompt: text, watermark, yellowed plastic, broken alarm
scenes.narration: Checking your alarms monthly ensures they are ready when seconds count.

scenes.visual_prompt: A wide, cinematic pull-back shot (dolly out) from a red fire extinguisher mounted on a clean white wall. The room opens up as the camera retreats, showing a perfectly organized and safe hallway bathed in soft morning light.
scenes.visual_reference: A well-prepared home with safety equipment in place.
scenes.negative_prompt: text, watermark, clutter, dark, scary, fire
scenes.narration: A few minutes of inspection today can protect your home for years to come.
